text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...!? Wha... What on earth was that just 
now!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm surprised. But it doesn't feel bad 
at all. In fact, my chest feels so 
warm..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's as if power is overflowing from 
within me...!
